# World Sweets Kuwait
> Kuwait's leading confectionery distributor since 1986

## About
World Sweets is a family-run company founded in 1986 that has evolved into Kuwait's premier confectionery distributor. With 150+ skilled professionals, two showrooms (Shuwaikh and Fahaheel), and partnerships with leading international brands.
